integrity: Every proper simple game through four players is enumerated from its minimal-winning antichain. Both indices are computed independently in two exact rational formulations, divergent games are canonicalized under all player relabelings, and weighted representations are independently searched.
scientific_limitations: The classification is exact only for proper simple games through four players and compares weak player rankings rather than numerical distances. If properness is dropped, divergence already occurs at three players.
title: Sharp four-player ordinal divergence layer for Deegan–Packel and the Public Good index
